dinner.name: Chivito (Uruguayan Grilled Steak Sandwich)
dinner.description: Uruguayan grilled steak sandwich with toppings - hearty sandwich dinner
ingredients: 400g beef steak (sirloin or rib eye), thinly sliced
2 crusty bread rolls or sandwich rolls
instructions: Cook bacon in skillet until crispy, remove and chop
In same skillet, fry eggs sunny-side up, set aside
Season beef slices with salt, pepper, minced garlic
Heat skillet over high heat, quickly sear beef until cooked (total 2-3 minutes)
Spread mayonnaise on rolls if desired
Layer bottom of roll: lettuce, tomato slices, cooked beef
Top with ham, mozzarella cheese, bacon pieces, fried egg
dinner.notes: All components should be hot when assembled. Chivito is eaten for lunch or dinner
dinner.fun_fact: Chivito is Uruguay's national sandwich, created in Montevideo in 1960s
